name: Indou Ranko
source:
A female police inspector who speaks in a suspicious Osaka dialect and is in charge of the Historical Archives Section. She is the protagonist's superior, but she rarely does any real work, instead spending most of her time watching TV or engaging in public gambling. 
Occasionally, she shows her extensive knowledge of the occult, making her a mysterious figure.
